neighbours.label: the word just before ' it' when 'it' is a thing or organization (when it, how it, once it, has made it), as opposed to the same structures before he, she or they
fire: The airline must explain its prices and how it treats customers.
The satellite will send data once it reaches orbit.
The tower is admired, and its height has made it a landmark.
The bank will lose money if it lends to the wrong firms.
The probe carries a camera when it descends to the surface.
A tooth can be saved once it has cracked.
The school needs funds for the land that it rents.
The ministry is reviewing what it spends on roads.
quiet: The pilot must explain his prices and how he treats customers.
The astronauts will send data once they reach orbit.
The actress is admired, and her beauty has made her a star.
The banker will lose money if he lends to the wrong firms.
The climber carries a camera when she descends to the camp.
A patient can be saved once she has arrived.
The teachers need funds for the land that they rent.
The minister is reviewing what he spends on roads.

short: just before ' it' (a thing or organization)
notes: Peak tokens vary: ' how', ' when', ' once', ' made', and the probe ending in 'it would apply' reached only 0.20. The card's top is ' of' in 'vice president of', which this does not explain.
